why: Turn 13 my main phase. Draw revealed a second Shock in hand. My burn package: Lightning Bolt (3) + Shock (2) + Shock (2) = 7 total damage available. Cast Lightning Bolt first on opponent's face (12 → 9 life). Follow with both Shocks (9 → 7 → 5 life). Opponent's Baloth is back to 4/4 (the Giant Growth and Titanic Growth expired at end of turn 12). After dealing 7 damage, opponent will have 4/4 attacker dealing 4 damage/turn next turn. With 7 life remaining, I survive and can draw into more burn on turn 14 to finish.
